item.title: Tune Up!!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Mutsu-gumi
  • 発売日: 2003-04-25
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ちゅ～んなっぷ!!
  • 英語名: Tune Up!!

别名

  • ちゅーんなっぷ！！

あらすじ

The protagonist, who has been losing every single job-hunting battle, suddenly experiences two strokes of luck.

One is being selected for the product development department (his dream job) of a top-class general electronics manufacturer founded by a distant relative.

The other is winning a large sum of money (1 million yen!) from a lottery ticket he bought on a whim.
